refinement.frequency_label: Training power-optimized fold frequency; not a precision clock estimate.
refinement.objective: Magnitude of Hann-weighted DTFT of mean-subtracted |IQ|^2; training block only.
refinement.assumptions: A detectable cyclic-power component shares the FAM harmonic-family frequency; sub-bin optimization supplies no confidence interval.

blocks.family_match_scope: Nearest later-block CDP peak to a frozen family frequency; descriptive proximity, not frozen k/l/q confirmation.

centers.inference_scope: Radiation periodicity and sideband hypotheses; no bit/byte/lane/packet decoding.
centers.two_cycle_scope: F/2 folding is a derived comparison; a split odd-half-order family need not have a peak at F/2.
centers.uncertainty_scope: FFT spacing, tolerance intervals and DTFT optimization are not statistical confidence intervals.
